dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent heart-shaped annulus on the mid-dorsal region featuring a jagged, high-intensity perimeter transitioning to a dark core; several circular and C-shaped annuli on the lateral flank with sharply defined white borders and high-contrast interior-exterior gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized white pixel clusters distributed along the lateral-ventral transition and concentrated near the posterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent annuli on the mid-flank form an asymmetrical triangle; additional keypoints from smaller clusters on the posterior region align in an irregular polygon following the body's lateral curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: The rear flipper exhibits a significantly lower density of high-contrast patterning compared to the torso, appearing as a near-uniform dark intensity region with only minor specular highlights on the digital margins.
